name: init
summary: Make the current folder, or the --workspace folder, a Workspace.
description:
Make the current folder, or the --workspace folder, a Workspace.

Creates only what is missing: the data folder with its .gitignore and crawls folder, and a commented settings file. It never changes an existing file, and it checks an existing settings file first.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: The Workspace folder. Without it, the nearest folder upwards that holds .openlinx/ or openlinx.toml, else the global Workspace ~/.openlinx.

examples.description: Make the current folder a Workspace.
Create the folder site and make it a Workspace.
